training.title: Sample: Return Policy Acknowledgment
training.acknowledgment: I understand the sample return policy and will follow it with every customer.

lines.first_message: Hi! I'm Anne. This is a short sample training on an example return policy. We'll go through two quick topics, and at the end I'll ask you to confirm out loud that you understand it. Ready?
lines.welcome_back_walkthrough: Welcome back! Let's pick up where we left off.
lines.acknowledgment_intro: That covers the policy. The last step is a quick confirmation.
lines.welcome_back_acknowledgment: Welcome back! You've been through the policy already, so there's just one quick confirmation left.
lines.completed: Thank you, that's recorded. You've completed the return policy acknowledgment.
lines.feedback_question: Before we wrap up, on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate this training? And in a sentence or two, what worked for you and what didn't?
lines.already_passed: Welcome back! You've already completed the return policy acknowledgment. Want a quick refresher on the policy, or are you all set?

lines.text: This is an example policy for a sample training. Customers can return most accessories within 14 days of purchase, with the receipt, in the original packaging.
How long do customers have to return an accessory under this example policy?
14 days, with the receipt and the original packaging.
Always explain the return policy honestly before the sale. Never promise a return or refund the policy doesn't allow just to close a sale.
A customer asks if they can return a case after a month. What do you tell them?
Honestly that the example policy only allows returns within 14 days, so a return after a month wouldn't qualify.
no, it's past 14 days; be honest that it's outside the window.
Be upfront about the policy every time, even if it costs you the sale.
